newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss, Russian prosecutors in anti-mafia pledge.
newsitem.headline: Swiss, Russian prosecutors in anti-mafia pledge.

text.p: Swiss Federal Prosecutor Carla Del Ponte and her Russian counterpart pledged on Tuesday to work together to fight organised crime, the Swiss news agency SDA said.
"My concern is to prevent the Russian mafia from infiltrating the financial centre here (Switzerland)," SDA quoted Del Ponte as saying after talks with Prosecutor-General Yuri Skuratov.

Del Ponte said late last year she had evidence that Russian gangs were trying to move their crime profits into Switzerland despite anti-money laundering laws that have been progressively tightened since the late 1980s.
SDA said Skuratov told reporters he also wanted to work with Swiss authorities and that the two sides would set up a joint working group on organised crime and money laundering.
Skuratov's four-day visit included talks with regional prosecutors in Zurich and Geneva, the country's main banking and financial hubs, SDA said.
Skuratov told reporters that in Geneva he would also look into the case of a Russian national living in Switzerland, Sergei Mikhailov.
Mikhailov was arrested at Geneva airport last October 16 and is being held for investigation on charges of criminal links and money-laundering.
